hold_text: HELD for the manager's review (TRADEIFY-WIRE, the two T2 review nits PI-20260930-BHYHMK2H-0001, due before T5). Tier-2: the prop ticket emitter's refusal path and the order-package terminal write in execute_pkg. Places no order; changes no cap or sizing.
why: (1) A leverage-cap check on an account whose declared ruleset is missing or unreadable now refuses ('could not look') instead of reading 'no rule declared'. (2) A ticket the emitter refused (journaled status=skipped: sizing skip, $-cap or firm-rule refusal) no longer stamps its order package 'emitted'; it records rejected / prop_ticket_skipped. Both live-branch package writes are now CONDITIONAL (status open AND no linked trade), the #14672 guard generalised, so a prop leg never overwrites another account's outcome on a shared package. Also files PI-20261001-BHYHMK2I-0001 (Tradeify watchlist DOM blocks T4/T5).
